sounding_object.description: An adult male with a blurred face, wearing a light green short-sleeved polo shirt and blue jeans. He has short, dark hair (visible at the edges of the blur) and is wearing glasses (also somewhat blurred but discernible). He is initially sitting at a wooden table, then moves to and sits on a beige couch. While on the couch, he is holding a black smartphone. Approximate height while sitting is around 0.8-1.0 meters (torso and head).

reference_object.description: The camera worn by the first person, representing the viewer's egocentric perspective. This is the origin point (0,0) for distance and direction measurements.

facing_object.description: Empty as the reference object is the camera in egocentric mode.

question: Imagine you are the camera wearer, when the speech topic "stating purchase of endeavor stock" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the other person: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
